name: @equin/plugin-debug-profiling-tab-memory
description: Tab memory, the parts a heap snapshot cannot see: clean-soak spawns chrome-headless-shell with nothing attached to the page and reads Chrome's memory-infra dumps per allocator (v8, malloc, partition_alloc, blink_gc, web_cache…) over an idle soak or in-app navigation rounds; listener-probe attributes a tab's event-listener growth to the stacks that add it.
